interpretation: Exploratory conditional association in the completed ESMFold snapshot. Structural predictions derive from sequences; circularity remains. Extant RSA and confidence summaries are not ancestral or phylogenetically weighted. Marker clusters need not be fully independent. No claim that the full lineage-wide objective is complete.
